premises.text: Idle cash in peer-to-peer payment apps earns returns for the apps while inflation erodes users' balances
premises.evidence_span: those same peer-to-peer apps that are benefiting from cash balances and earning a return, leaving nothing behind for their users

premises.text: Young users want to grow wealth but often lack resources, time, or energy to invest
premises.evidence_span: Millennials, Gen Z, all of us want to earn and grow our wealth, but sometimes just lack the resources, time, or energy or resources to invest

premises.text: Peer-to-peer paybacks can be settled in the recipient's chosen stocks instead of only cash
premises.evidence_span: her top five favorite stocks pop up, and I can choose whatever I wanna pay her in

premises.text: Sends move as cash until the recipient accepts, then convert to stock, alternate stock, or cash
premises.evidence_span: It only converts to stock once she clicks Accept in her Notifications tab

premises.text: Public portfolios, trades, and comments make investing social and transparent
premises.evidence_span: we make all portfolios and trades and transactions public, so you can like and comment on various transactions

premises.text: Brokerage-partner coverage protects user cash and portfolio balances
premises.evidence_span: We cover up to 250K of user cash balances and 500K of portfolio investments using our brokerage partner, Alpaca
